provenance.method: Extracted once from an independently generated run after all 22 files matched the committed macOS reference. The Binder runner never generates or updates this reference.
provenance.reviewed_expectations: 4 questions; 3 synthetic participants; 12 responses; 8 correct; 3 revisions; T0=2/4, T1=4/4, T2=2/4
provenance.physical_database_scope: SQLite page layout and the database hash/size in manifest may vary across platforms; all SQLite schema objects, table/view values and storage types, encoding, user_version and application_id are fixed.

manifest_metadata.note: Input snapshot and analysis outputs before optional workbook generation; originals remain live and unmodified.

schema: CREATE INDEX idx_assignments_doctor_order ON assignments(doctor_id, display_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_questions_difficulty ON questions(difficulty, difficulty_level)
CREATE INDEX idx_responses_doctor_order ON responses(doctor_id, display_order)

CREATE TABLE answer_keys (
  study_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  gold_answer_idx TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (gold_answer_idx IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D')),
  gold_answer_text TEXT,
  source_dataset TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (study_id, question_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (study_id, question_id) REFERENCES questions(study_id, question_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE assignments (
  assignment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  study_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  doctor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  doctor_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (doctor_level IN ('senior', 'junior')),
  question_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  difficulty TEXT NOT NULL,
  condition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (condition IN ('T0', 'T1', 'T2')),
  stage_block TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stage_block IN ('baseline', 'cdss_advice')),
  display_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  block_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (study_id) REFERENCES studies(study_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (study_id, doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors(study_id, doctor_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (study_id, question_id) REFERENCES questions(study_id, question_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE cdss_advice (
  assignment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  cdss_answer_idx TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cdss_answer_idx IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D')),
  cdss_answer_text TEXT,
  advice_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  confidence REAL,
  FOREIGN KEY (assignment_id) REFERENCES assignments(assignment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE doctors (
  study_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  doctor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  doctor_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (doctor_level IN ('senior', 'junior')),
  PRIMARY KEY (study_id, doctor_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (study_id) REFERENCES studies(study_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE questions (
  study_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_order TEXT,
  difficulty TEXT NOT NULL,
  difficulty_level TEXT,
  question_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  option_a TEXT NOT NULL,
  option_b TEXT NOT NULL,
  option_c TEXT NOT NULL,
  option_d TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (study_id, question_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (study_id) REFERENCES studies(study_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE TABLE response_changes (assignment_id TEXT, change_order INTEGER, from_answer TEXT, to_answer TEXT, changed_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(assignment_id) REFERENCES responses(assignment_id))

CREATE TABLE responses (
  record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  doctor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  doctor_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (doctor_level IN ('senior', 'junior')),
  question_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  difficulty TEXT NOT NULL,
  condition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (condition IN ('T0', 'T1', 'T2')),
  stage_block TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stage_block IN ('baseline', 'cdss_advice')),
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  display_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  block_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  has_cdss INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (has_cdss IN (0, 1)),
  cdss_answer_idx TEXT,
  doctor_answer_idx TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (doctor_answer_idx IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D')),
  matches_cdss INTEGER CHECK (matches_cdss IN (0, 1)),
  response_time_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  note TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (assignment_id) REFERENCES assignments(assignment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE studies (
  study_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  generated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_dataset TEXT,
  design_type TEXT,
  difficulty_counts_json TEXT,
  doctor_count INTEGER,
  records_per_question INTEGER,
  doctor_facing INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  gold_answers_included INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE VIEW scored_responses AS SELECT r.*, k.gold_answer_idx, (r.doctor_answer_idx=k.gold_answer_idx) AS doctor_is_correct FROM responses r JOIN assignments a ON a.assignment_id=r.assignment_id JOIN answer_keys k ON k.study_id=a.study_id AND k.question_id=a.question_id

rows: Synthetic arithmetic only; no MedQA or participant data
